result_summary.title: Provisioning delays and duplicate accounts in Dev Invoice Service
result_summary.description: We are seeing issues in our US-West development environment with the Invoice Service. Provisioning tasks appear to be stuck, and there are noticeable synchronization delays between systems. Additionally, some of these delays seem to result in duplicate accounts being created. About 38 users are affected, creating a moderate impact on our dev team's workflow. It's unclear if this is specific to the invoice provisioning logic or a broader subscription billing issue.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the idempotency of the provisioning logic in the Invoice Service and review the upstream dependency configuration of the Login UI.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case is likely related to an upstream dependency issue with the Login UI, which is causing provisioning delays and duplicate accounts in the Invoice Service. The root cause is suspected to be an idempotency/duplicate-processing failure. The affected component is the Login UI, and the owning team is the Identity team.
